Terrible experience.

I took my dog ​​to this veterinary clinic for blood tests. They simply took a sample without examining him, even though it was obvious he wasn't well.

After receiving some of the results, they contacted me saying the values ​​weren't good and that they would send me the rest of the tests the next day. However, not only did I never receive those results, but no one alerted me to the urgency of the situation or advised me to take the dog to a clinic immediately, even though some of the values ​​were extremely low.

Fortunately, I went to another veterinary clinic, where they immediately recognized the seriousness of the clinical situation. Thanks to blood transfusions and splenic surgery, my dog ​​survived.

I consider the lack of communication and timeliness in managing such a delicate case to be extremely serious. As for me, I will never return to this veterinary clinic.

Laura and Imma aren't just two veterinarians: they are two extraordinary people who dedicate their lives to animals with skill, passion, and a huge heart.

Over the years, they have been at our side for many cats in the colony, for stray cats rescued from the streets, and for all those little ones who needed care, attention, and a chance. They never backed down from an emergency, a cry for help, or a difficult case.

A special thank you goes to my Esme, whom they supported with great professionalism and love through a delicate journey, helping her recover and always accompanying us with clarity, helpfulness, and humanity.

Every cat that comes to them is treated as a unique individual, with respect and affection. It's something you can immediately sense and that makes all the difference.

For those of us who work with cat colonies and rescue animals in need, knowing we can count on such well-trained and always available professionals is a priceless security.

Thank you, Laura and Imma, for everything you do every day, for my house cats and the colony, and for all the strays you've helped reunite.
I love the place, the girl who works there and the doctor are so friendly 😍 I took Kelly for her vaccinations 😍 and everything was great …
Competent doctors, very helpful, patient and affectionate both with me and my cat.
